tools.name: search_apps
tools.description: Search the iOS App Store and Google Play (both merged by default) to find apps and their ids. Use this FIRST when you only know an app name or a category.

tools.name: mine_app_pain_points
tools.description: THE core tool: fetch recent reviews of any iOS/Android app, keep the negative ones, and cluster them into ranked pain points (title, sharePercent, severity 1-5, verbatim evidence quotes). Ideal for competitive research and product discovery. Cached 7 days (instant on repeat); a COLD server-side anal

tools.name: get_pain_trend
tools.description: How an app's pain points changed over time: compares two archived analyses and labels each theme new / resolved / rising / falling / stable with share deltas (percentage points). Instant (archive read, no LLM). Default: latest vs ~30 days earlier. Returns a note when the app has fewer than two snaps

tools.name: get_app_details
tools.description: App metadata: name, developer, category, price, average rating, rating count and 1-5★ histogram (when available).

tools.name: get_version_history
tools.description: Per-version review stats (review count, average rating, first/last seen) — spot a rating crash right after a bad release. Android: aggregated from recent reviews. iOS: current version + release notes.

tools.name: watch_competitors
tools.description: Continuous competitor monitoring (paid plans: Starter 2 apps weekly, Pro 15 apps daily). Manage the watchlist and the alert destination; digests of NEW 1-2★ reviews and NEW/RISING pain points are pushed to a Slack / Discord / any https webhook. action: list | add | remove | set_webhook | test.

tools.name: get_app_reviews
tools.description: Fetch raw app reviews (unified schema across stores: rating/title/body/version/date/devReply/thumbsUp), 50 per page. Use for drill-down after mine_app_pain_points.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mine_app_pain_points, get_version_history, watch_competitors, get_app_reviews · Public sink: get_pain_trend, watch_competitors · Destructive: watch_competitors.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mine_app_pain_points, get_version_history, watch_competitors, get_app_reviews · Public sink: get_pain_trend, watch_competitors · Destructive: watch_competitors

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
